Run the Tumor2Line workflow

Source: R/04_run_tumor2line.R
run_tumor2line.Rd

Runs the standard Tumor2Line analysis from a query expression population and a candidate cell-line expression population. Query samples may represent patient tumors, PDOs, PDXs, organoids, or other tumor-derived models.

Usage

run_tumor2line(
  query_expr,
  cellline_expr,
  phenotype = NULL,
  sample_id_col = "SampleID",
  pair_col = NULL,
  lineage_col = NULL,
  sample_type_col = NULL,
  query_type = "query",
  cellline_type = "cellline",
  min_mean_tpm = 0.1,
  min_detected_fraction = 0.1,
  n_variable_genes = 10000,
  pca_variance_threshold = 0.9,
  max_pcs = NULL,
  candidate_scope = c("within_lineage", "global"),
  distance = c("euclidean", "manhattan", "cosine"),
  epsilon = 0.1,
  rho_query = 1,
  rho_cellline = 1,
  max_iter = 5000,
  tolerance = 1e-08,
  evaluate = TRUE
)

Arguments

query_expr

Expression data for the query population. Samples are rows and genes are columns.

cellline_expr

Candidate cell-line expression data in the same orientation as `query_expr`.

phenotype

Optional sample metadata.

sample_id_col

Sample-ID column name in `phenotype`.

pair_col

Optional known-pair column name. Set to `NULL` when known query-cell-line pairs are unavailable.

lineage_col

Optional cancer-lineage column name. Set to `NULL` when lineage information is unavailable.

sample_type_col

Optional column describing biological sample type, such as tumor, PDO, PDX, organoid, or cell line.

query_type

Default biological label assigned to query samples when `sample_type_col` is unavailable.

cellline_type

Default biological label assigned to cell-line samples when `sample_type_col` is unavailable.

min_mean_tpm

Minimum mean TPM for gene filtering.

min_detected_fraction

Minimum detected fraction for gene filtering.

n_variable_genes

Maximum number of variable genes.

pca_variance_threshold

Cumulative PCA variance threshold used to determine the number of retained PCs.

max_pcs

Optional maximum number of PCs to fit. If `NULL`, all available PCs are considered and the final number of PCs is determined by `pca_variance_threshold`.

candidate_scope

Candidate pool: `"within_lineage"` or `"global"`.

distance

Distance metric used to construct the uOT cost matrix.

epsilon

Entropic regularization parameter.

rho_query

Query-population marginal-relaxation parameter.

rho_cellline

Cell-line marginal-relaxation parameter.

max_iter

Maximum Sinkhorn iterations.

tolerance

Sinkhorn convergence tolerance.

evaluate

Whether to evaluate known pairs automatically when available.

Value

An object of class `Tumor2LineResult`.

Details

The standard workflow performs common-gene harmonization, log2(TPM + 1) transformation, variable-gene selection, joint gene scaling, PCA, scaled PC representation, and population-aware unbalanced optimal transport (uOT) matching.

Known query-cell-line pairs are not required. When known pairs are supplied through `pair_col`, they can optionally be used for downstream evaluation.
